items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: So Martin Kirch, Joe Castro, my brother Lance, and myself... we walked about a block away from where the band was congregated, got out on the corner and played German band music

ctx.x: Did they ever use any hymns in any of these jazz tunes? Any who? Hymns. You know, religious tunes. No, no, no. You know, they do that now. You hear them take these spirals. Yeah. Yeah,

they, they, they, they use some of them. And we never did that. We had no occasion, for the simple reason it was, we had a repertoire that we could play all night and never play the same thing over. When you play 32 dances at a ball in six hours, and you don't play no repeats, you ain't, you don't need no hymns. Did Jacqueline ever tell you about the day we put on the German band over the river? No, I didn't. Did you ever hear the Logical Point? Yes, I have heard of that. Did you ever hear it, Parker? No. We went…
